title: Supplemental Bible Fragments — Memory Operators & Recovered Chains
purpose: Supply short public-domain scripture fragments for the recovered memory/operator relations. Context and interpretation remain in specialist owner files.

fragments.text: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
He spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud, and said to him, ‘Go, wash in the pool of Siloam.’
God made the animals of the earth after their kind ... God saw that it was good.
Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
You have put off the old man with his doings, and have put on the new man.
Lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven ... for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.
For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth.
I saw a new heaven and a new earth.
